notes.title: Major Gameplay Update Full Version is Now LIVE!! (Version 0.10.3)
notes.content:
[b][color=#5DADE2]Hello everyone!

After more than a month of iterative development and updates, the gameplay update patch has finally been fully released. This patch greatly enhances the playability of the game and simplifies the gameplay operations and complexity. Below is a complete overview of the patch details. Please also note that after this discount promotion, the game price will slightly increase.

[h2]Adjustments and Optimizations[/h2] [list] 
[*]Tutorials related to game movement, campaigns, battles, and design have been added.
[*]The function to manually set attack modules has been added, and it can be activated by pressing the spacebar during battles.
[*]At the start of the battle, the player’s spawn position will dynamically adjust based on the detection range of the ships.
[*]Campaigns can unlock out-of-game options, such as increasing initial funds or enhancing enemy difficulty.
[*]Campaigns can unlock and collect enemy ships, and other ships can be imported from campaign mode to assist in design.
[*]In the transformation panel, manually entering the position will modify the entire translation module, rather than setting it in the same position.
[*]The default mode of the rotation tool has been changed to constant and can be modified in the design interface.
[*]The functionality of the hide module has been optimized, allowing manual hiding and category-based hiding to take effect simultaneously.
[*]The functionality of ship connection detection has been optimized, and issues with ship connection failures will occur less frequently.
[*]The color hint effect of the selected module has been optimized.
[*]The ability to select a range in the module list using the Shift key has been added.
[*]The display logic of the connector controller has been optimized.
[*]The function to randomly customize colors in the design has been added.
[*]The energy consumption and heat dissipation of kinetic weapons have been reduced.
[*]The AI movement algorithm has been adjusted to actively maintain a certain distance from the target and attempt to attack the enemy from the side.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the obstacle avoidance bug caused by AI having detached modules inside the hull, which led to the AI continuously accelerating in one direction.
[*]The phenomenon of flickering after overlapping modules on the same plane has been reduced.
[*]Fixed the bug where the core would become disordered when importing ships.
[*]Fixed the bug where mirrored modules could not be manually hidden.
[*]Fixed the bug where the rotation value was incorrect in the surface alignment mode of the pick-and-place tool.
[*]Fixed the bug where the laser effect position was inaccurate.
[/list]

[h2]Roguelite Campaign Gameplay[/h2] 
[olist] 
[*]The remade campaign gameplay has very rich roguelite features. Players need to destroy the enemy’s attack while improving and strengthening their own ships in 30 rounds. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/2dcd456a28d4c6cf14c0b555a2be2e6fb87fa3bb.jpg[/img]
[*]After each level up, you will get random skill rewards, and even have a chance to get [color=#E74C3C]legendary[/color] rare skills. By combining your own ship design and [color=#E74C3C]skill build[/color], you can greatly enhance the ability of the ship, even a battleship against a fleet. 
[*]During the round, the galaxy map will collapse due to space instability. Therefore, players not only need to consider how to circumvent the enemy in space, but also [color=#E74C3C]plan the route[/color] to avoid being isolated by the collapsed galaxy. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/ff1091fa536ce7e8045d0e3dc4c545830ae05d9f.jpg[/img]
[*]Players will get [color=#E74C3C]unlock points[/color] at the end of each campaign, which can unlock more powerful modules outside the game, and build their own exclusive initial campaign ship. 
[/olist]

[h2]Ship Rating Mechanism[/h2] 
[olist]
[*]In the new version, the construction of ships is no longer constrained by the number of modules, but is determined by the total cost. Each module has different cost values according to its function, attributes, level, and size. Players need to decide their spaceship design ideas within a certain cost limit, whether they focus on firepower, mobility, or defensive capabilities, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/eba022c5eb2df7b8b4c1141ed090553606ae40e1.jpg[/img]
[*]Added a six-dimensional attribute chart for ships, namely [color=#E74C3C]firepower, movement, reach, tenacity, stealth, command[/color], players can get more intuitive ship design feedback from the six-dimensional attribute chart, and grasp the trend of ship capability changes in real time. 
[*]According to different cost intervals, ships are divided into [color=#E74C3C]F, E, D, C, B, A, S[/color] seven levels. These levels give players a rough reference for judging the strength of the ship, and players can also set the highest level of the ship allowed in the room in custom battles. In sandbox mode, the ship will get skill points for each level upgrade, which can be used to add buff effects to the ship. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/5e37c6c31e82d62b6f63f9e0a8cd2f5fda694523.jpg[/img]
[/olist]

[/color][/b]

notes.title: Feature Update v0.9.8-r2 — Transform Hand Tool
notes.content:
[b][color=#5DADE2]
Hello everyone, this week’s update brings some important updates.

[h3]抓取放置工具[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/9fa1c57988f9cfd72c7c213ac5fdb1a27bfba3ce.jpg[/img]
A new Grab and Place tool has been added. After selecting a module, pressing the space bar will pick up the module, then moving the mouse to the target module, the grabbed module will be placed on the surface of the target module. During the grabbing process, pressing the left Alt key can switch between maintaining rotation mode and fitting surface mode. In addition, a plane moving mode has been added to the displacement tool to simplify operation.

[h3]Campaign Mode Improvement[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/8e0618e43519d86fda7f580a1647fe52356439ea.jpg[/img]
[olist]
[*]Added the function of collecting enemy ships. After you defeat the enemy in the campaign, you can obtain the enemy’s design. It can be read in the design game.
[*]Campaign mode can now import ships in the design scene, including enemy ships. This way you don’t have to re-place modules every time, but be aware that you cannot use modules that you have not yet unlocked.
[*]Added campaign history scores, which can be viewed at the start of the campaign interface.
[*]Added the function of using unlock points to increase the initial deployment value, so players can bring more powerful ships at the start.
[*]Added the function of setting the initial parameters of the campaign, which can increase the game’s score and experience by enhancing the enemy’s deployment value or quantity. For players who pursue challenges, they can get a better gaming experience.
[/olist]

[h3]Other Updates[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Increase the detection range of the ship to the maximum, and replace the original detection range with the identification range. In this way, the ship can detect local targets from a long distance, but the weapons cannot lock on and fire until they have entered the identification range.
[*]Added the function of sorting the ship list, which can be sorted by name or cost.
[*]Optimized some UI displays.
[*]Fixed the bug where ships could not be repaired in campaign mode.
[*]Fixed the bug with the moving grid.
[/olist]

These improvements should significantly improve the overall gaming experience, hope you guys will like it.
[/color][/b]

notes.title: Feature Update v0.9.7-r3 — New Navigation Controller
notes.content:
[b][color=#5DADE2]
Hello, everyone! This week’s updates bring some significant improvements:

[h3]Navigation Controller[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/cada4faf3124d6744e58721591ebd304017565f1.jpg[/img]
The new navigation controller displays both attitude information and velocity data on a single HUD interface. You can control attitude using the keyboard (WASDQE) and velocity by dragging the mouse. Additionally, horizontal and vertical azimuth coordinates enhance clarity for the ship’s heading.

[h3]Relative Target Movement Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/eadba2f60357bffdce5518b2d836f87446a39318.jpg[/img]
We’ve introduced a new movement mode: relative target displacement. When you set a target, switch to “relative target” velocity mode. Use the scan panel to define displacement direction and magnitude relative to the target—an excellent way to choose optimal engagement angles.

[h3]Other Updates[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Zoom distance adapts to ship size.
[*]Observation mirror remembers the last position.
[*]UI for ship controls is optimized.
[*]A missile flight logic bug is fixed.
[*]Attempt to fix a bug will cause crash.
[*]The UI interaction logic of the design interface has been optimized. 
[*]The export function has been modified to export the currently activated ship.
[*]Fixed the bug where the quality couldn’t be displayed correctly in the overview interface.
[*]Fixed the bug that allowed skipping the charging phase when activating shields. 
[/olist]
These enhancements should significantly improve the overall gameplay experience. Hope you will like it.
[/color][/b]

notes.title: Major Gameplay Update is Now LIVE!!
notes.content:
[b][color=#5DADE2]Hello everyone!

After more than two months of careful preparation, we bring you a very significant gameplay update. This update elevates the entire gameplay to a huge level and truly achieves the unity of sandbox construction and pigeon gameplay. Here is a brief introduction:

[h2]Roguelite Campaign Gameplay[/h2] 
[olist] 
[*]The remade campaign gameplay has very rich roguelite features. Players need to destroy the enemy’s attack while improving and strengthening their own ships in 30 rounds. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/2dcd456a28d4c6cf14c0b555a2be2e6fb87fa3bb.jpg[/img]

[*]During the round, the galaxy map will collapse due to space instability. Therefore, players not only need to consider how to circumvent the enemy in space, but also [color=#E74C3C]plan the route[/color] to avoid being isolated by the collapsed galaxy. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/ff1091fa536ce7e8045d0e3dc4c545830ae05d9f.jpg[/img]
[*]Players will get [color=#E74C3C]unlock points[/color] at the end of each campaign, which can unlock more powerful modules outside the game, and build their own exclusive initial campaign ship. 
[/olist]

[h2]Ship Rating Mechanism[/h2] 
[olist]
[*]In the new version, the construction of ships is no longer constrained by the number of modules, but is determined by the total cost. Each module has different cost values according to its function, attributes, level, and size. Players need to decide their spaceship design ideas within a certain cost limit, whether they focus on firepower, mobility, or defensive capabilities, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/eba022c5eb2df7b8b4c1141ed090553606ae40e1.jpg[/img]
[*]Added a six-dimensional attribute chart for ships, namely [color=#E74C3C]firepower, movement, reach, tenacity, stealth, command[/color], players can get more intuitive ship design feedback from the six-dimensional attribute chart, and grasp the trend of ship capability changes in real time. 
[*]According to different cost intervals, ships are divided into [color=#E74C3C]F, E, D, C, B, A, S[/color] seven levels. These levels give players a rough reference for judging the strength of the ship, and players can also set the highest level of the ship allowed in the room in custom battles. In sandbox mode, the ship will get skill points for each level upgrade, which can be used to add buff effects to the ship. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/5e37c6c31e82d62b6f63f9e0a8cd2f5fda694523.jpg[/img]
[/olist]

[h2]New Modules[/h2] 
[olist] 
[*][color=#E74C3C]Heavy Vertical Launch Missile System[/color], can pour firepower on your opponent from a super long distance. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/01f144f0e900cb36f451a990637557cfa526d2fc.png[/img]
[*][color=#E74C3C]Dedicated Radiator[/color], replaces the original heat dissipation function of the hull, and the function of the hull is transferred to structural damage. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/d12eed71b0a5f4deda472e32d69e796ebb3abcf0.png[/img]
[*][color=#E74C3C]Large Thruster[/color], provides ample power for S-level spacecraft. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/24ba676fa90b4d48d1ac30a4c94c843910996a72.png[/img]
[*][color=#E74C3C]Fusion Reactor[/color], provides a steady stream of energy for S-level ships. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/f3246ce93d1c2b94d07348e53c0ac58955dd2659.png[/img]
[*][color=#E74C3C]7 new rugged style hulls[/color], suitable for building ship contour shapes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/9e50cd39a541123ce131eb2e6872a0c7e84a03a7.png[/img]
 [/olist]

[h2]Other Adjustments and Optimizations[/h2] [list] 
[*]Remade and optimized the design operation UI and combat control UI, the hierarchical logic is clearer, and the visual effects are more beautiful. 
[*]Missiles have health, and missiles are destroyed when the health is 0. If the missile has been ignited, it will cause an explosion. The damage of point defense weapons becomes more meaningful. 
[*]The hull will share the damage suffered by other adjacent modules, thereby enhancing the robustness of the hull structure. Making the hull defensive becomes a more feasible solution. 
[*]Adjusted the AI’s moving algorithm, it will actively maintain a certain distance from the target, and try to attack the enemy from the side. 
[*]Adjusted the initial position mechanism of the encounter battle, the ships of the same team will be generated nearby. 
[*]Greatly reduced the size of the hull collider, the construction of the hull can reach a very deep penetration distance. 
[*]Added the setting of the maximum undo length in design mode, which can be changed in the settings menu. 
[*]Adjusted and optimized the flight algorithm of the missile, the missile will better achieve the drift effect in motion. 
[*]Optimized the algorithm and performance of the point defense turret, the point defense has a better defense effect. 
[/list]

Additionally, we are very sorry for the inconvenience. This update, aimed at improving everyone’s building experience, has significantly reduced the range of the ship body blocker and adjusted the origin positions of some modules. This has resulted in players’ original ships being in a separated state, requiring manual repair in the game. We ask for your understanding for any trouble this may have caused.

That’s all for this update, hope you guys like it! [/color][/b]

notes.title: Progress of the First Major Update
notes.content:
[b][color=orange]Hello, every architect. It has been a long time since last announcement, and the first major update has been delayed for so much time. I am very sorry about that. 

Now it's time to tell you the progress of current developement. As I mentioned in forum, the delay is because that I bring quite a lot of extra work into this update. Specifically, they are ship module assets high-res remaking and free color customization. And I will tell you why I made this decision at the end. At first let's see the outcome.

[h3]Comparing to old asset[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/941bee81f6880fb34effc78846f54ec7dca6ca0a.png[/img][h3]Damaged mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/69824f211fb7fa9e775104925051150b873fc014.png[/img][h3]Color customization[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/74841190727ba77bdb370bcc9313d7b66de135db.gif[/img][h3]More regions[/h3][expand]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/921fa27a1658dad810570919115e9ffaee8e9b97.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/761d3ff61723bf605d825f3fc7c4cc4d1b95d051.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41267568/a4e77193d2edfb6bb5d1801a64f246aad04505ec.gif[/img][/expand]

The first one is always the hardest one. and following module assets could be created much faster. With these new art skills, I believe various new modules is no longer a knotty problem in future.

As for a precise estimate update date, I really don't know. I wish it could be done in next two months. I will present to you some progress when it's time. Thank you so much for liking and supporting.
[/color][/b]

[h2]Why bring extra work?[/h2]
[color=cyan][expand]At first, obviously the new energy shield gameplay need a new model asset, However I can't find one proper model asset I could purchase on any platform (such as Unity Asset Store and Epic Art Station). So only way to implement the feature is to designing and modeling from scratch. For consistency art style, the newly created module should be designed targeting to old assets. However the old assets is bought from other artist, Without source file, It turns making new asset into a constrained and inefficient job. So I decide to remake and upgrade old assets into a new higher standard, and create new ones after then. 

Since I have decided to remake all old assets, there is also an essential feature that is long requested by you, more color customization. Obviously this is the most appropriate time to implement it. I decide to implement it to a real sandbox level, not more color options, but complete control by color assignment. I have tried to cooperate with others, but it didn't go well. Because this is not a usual workflow in industry, (there are color replacing features in many games, but the quality of most of them can't satisfy myself). I need a complete new approach to solve it.

Finally, I decided to learn and dig into domain of art myself. I took almost one month to learn basic operation and skills of blender, substance painter and substance designer. Then I tried to test different types of art asset creating procedure, such as high-poly mesh baking, high detailed surface material. These workflow has been proved to be inappropriate for the project. Although I found a proper workflow at last, I can't output a better asset quality then old ones until recently. Today I could say new asset quality is obviously better than the old ones. Great！[/expand][/color]

notes.title: Resource System Rework (Version 0.5.8)
notes.content:
[b][color=orange] Hello every architect! In this update, there is a total rework of resource system. Previous resource system gives a weak connection between resources and modules. So, it is quite difficult for players to plan their design when retrieving spoils or trading with merchant before. However, with new resource system, it is very intuitive and convenient to plan your design.
 [/color]
[h1] New Resource System [/h1]
[list]
[*] All module's construction needs one corresponding construction kit and some general construction material. Upgrading module will cost one corresponding enhancement kit to target level. General construction material's requirement is determined by module's size and level.
[*] When delete modules that already built. the construction kit and enhancement kit will not be returned. It will be exchanged to money by a quite low ratio comparing to its original price. General construction material will be returned by a moderate ratio.
[*] Redesign combat's spoils generation algorithm. Combat spoils come from three ways: (1) On the basis of you combat score (enemy combat power comparing to yours). (2) From enemies' storage. (3) From enemies' wreckages. So, if you could defeat your enemy quicker, and deal less damage, you will get more spoils.
[*] Adjust merchant's storage replenishment algorithm. Higher grade resource has fewer chance to be replenished.
[*] Increase Ammo, Propellant, Construction material generation quantity. You don't need to gather ammo all around world anymore.
[/list]
[h1] Other Improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*] Improve rotation input behavior in transform panel.
[*] Improve ship's heading indicator's behavior.
[/list]
[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix a bug that Z-axis sometimes inverse when switch between combined controller and attitude controller.
[*] Fix a bug that photograph camera cannot save and restore camera placement.
[/list]
[h1] Numeric Adjustment [/h1]
[list]
[*] Change damage and shoot interval properties of some turrets.
[*] Adjust torque multiplier property of thrusters.
[/list]
[color=orange] In next one or two weeks, I will still work on adventure improvement. See you then. [/color]
[/b]

(3) From enemies' wreckages. So, if you could defeat your enemy quicker, and deal less damage, you will get more spoils.
